type.description: Type of logger either std_out or file

color.description: Use colored log level in std_out logger

file_name.description: Output log file for the file logger

max_file_size.description: Maximum file size in bytes before rolling to a new file (0 = disabled)

max_archived_files.description: Maximum number of archived log files to keep (0 = disabled)

max_cache_size.description: Number of bytes per thread used to store tile data in memory

id_table_size.description: Value controls the initial size of the Id table

use_lru_mem_cache.description: Use memory cache with LRU eviction policy

lru_mem_cache_hard_control.description: Use hard memory limit control for LRU memory cache (i.e. on every put) - never allow overcommit

use_simple_mem_cache.description: Use memory cache within a simple hash map the clears all tiles when overcommitted

user_agent.description: User-Agent http header to request single tiles

tile_url.description: Http location to read tiles from if they are not found in the tile_dir, e.g.: http://your_valhalla_tile_server_host:8000/some/Optional/path/{tilePath}?some=Optional&query=params. Valhalla will look for the {tilePath} portion of the url and fill this out with a given tile path when it make a request for that tile

tile_url_gz.description: Whether or not to request for compressed tiles

tile_url_user_pw.description: User & password for HTTP basic auth in the form of "user:password"

concurrency.description: How many threads to use in the concurrent parts of tile building

data_quality_dir.description: The directory where we output files regarding data quality issues, e.g. duplicateways.txt

tile_extract.description: Location to read tiles from tar

traffic_extract.description: Location to read traffic from tar

incident_dir.description: Location to read incident tiles from

incident_log.description: Location to read change events of incident tiles

shortcut_caching.description: Precaches the superseded edges of all shortcuts in the graph. Defaults to false

graph_lua_name.description: Location of the lua file to use for graph customization during tile building instead of default one

admin.description: Location of sqlite file holding admin polygons created with valhalla_build_admins

landmarks.description: Location of sqlite file holding landmark POI created with valhalla_build_landmarks

timezone.description: Location of sqlite file holding timezone information created with valhalla_build_timezones

transit_dir.description: Location of intermediate transit tiles created with valhalla_build_transit

transit_feeds_dir.description: Location of all GTFS transit feeds, needs to contain one subdirectory per feed

transit_bounding_box.description: Add comma separated bounding box values to only download transit data inside the given bounding box

transit_pbf_limit.description: Limit individual PBF files to this many trips (needed for PBF's stupid size limit)

hierarchy.description: bool indicating whether road hierarchy is to be built - default to True

shortcuts.description: bool indicating whether shortcuts are to be built - default to True

keep_all_osm_node_ids.description: bool indicating whether to store all OSM node ids in the graph data - defaults to False

keep_osm_node_ids.description: bool indicating whether to store OSM node ids (at topological/graph nodes) in the graph data - defaults to False

include_platforms.description: bool indicating whether to include highway=platform - default to False

include_driveways.description: bool indicating whether private driveways are included - default to True

include_construction.description: bool indicating where roads under construction are included - default to False

include_bicycle.description: bool indicating whether cycling only ways are included - default to True

include_pedestrian.description: bool indicating whether pedestrian only ways are included - default to True

include_driving.description: bool indicating whether driving only ways are included - default to True

import_bike_share_stations.description: bool indicating whether importing bike share stations(BSS). Set to True when using multimodal - default to False

global_synchronized_cache.description: bool indicating whether global_synchronized_cache is used - default to False

max_concurrent_reader_users.description: number of threads in the threadpool which can be used to fetch tiles over the network via curl

reclassify_links.description: bool indicating whether or not to reclassify links - reclassifies ramps based on the lowest class connecting road

pedestrian_areas.description: bool indicating whether or not to generate traversal edges for pedestrian areas - default to False

default_speeds_config.description: a path indicating the json config file which graph enhancer will use to set the speeds of edges in the graph based on their geographic location (state/country), density (urban/rural), road class, road use (form of way)

dataset_id.description: Optional integer id to identify the tile dataset. By default we try to set the maximum OSM changeset ID.

infer_internal_intersections.description: bool indicating whether or not to infer internal intersections during the graph enhancer phase or use the internal_intersection key from the pbf

infer_turn_channels.description: bool indicating whether or not to infer turn channels during the graph enhancer phase or use the turn_channel key from the pbf

apply_country_overrides.description: bool indicating whether or not to apply country overrides during the graph enhancer phase

use_admin_db.description: bool indicating whether or not to use the administrative database during the graph enhancer phase or use the admin keys from the pbf that are set on the node

use_direction_on_ways.description: bool indicating whether or not to process the direction key on the ways or utilize the guidance relation tags during the parsing phase

allow_alt_name.description: bool indicating whether or not to process the alt_name key on the ways during the parsing phase

use_urban_tag.description: bool indicating whether or not to use the urban area tag on the ways or to utilize the getDensity function within the graph enhancer phase

use_rest_area.description: bool indicating whether or not to use the rest/service area tag on the ways

scan_tar.description: bool indicating whether or not to pre-scan the tar ball(s) when loading an extract with an index file, to warm up the OS page cache.

build_bounding_circles.description: bool indicating whether to store 32-bit bounding circles for edges analogous to the edge bins inside level 2 graph tiles. This option is currently disabled.

elevation_url.description: Http location to read elevations from. this address is used if elevation tiles were not found in the elevation directory. Ex.: http://<your_valhalla_tile_server_host>:<your_valhalla_tile_server_port>/some/Optional/path/{tilePath}?some=Optional&query=params. Valhalla will look for the {tilePath} portion of the url and fill this out with an elevation path when it makes a request for that particular elevation

elevation_url_user_pw.description: User & password for HTTP basic auth in the form of "user:password"

actions.description: Comma separated list of allowable actions for the service, one or more of: locate, route, height, optimized_route, isochrone, trace_route, trace_attributes, transit_available, expansion, centroid, status, tile

use_connectivity.description: a boolean value to know whether or not to construct the connectivity maps

radius.description: Default radius to apply to incoming locations should one not be supplied

minimum_reachability.description: Default minimum reachability to apply to incoming locations should one not be supplied

search_cutoff.description: The cutoff at which we will assume the input is too far away from civilisation to be worth correlating to the nearest graph elements

node_snap_tolerance.description: During edge correlation this is the tolerance used to determine whether or not to snap to the intersection rather than along the street, if the snap location is within this distance from the intersection the intersection is used instead

street_side_tolerance.description: If your input coordinate is less than this tolerance away from the edge centerline then we set your side of street to none otherwise your side of street will be left or right depending on direction of travel

street_side_max_distance.description: The max distance in meters that the input coordinates or display ll can be from the edge centerline for them to be used for determining the side of street. Beyond this distance the side of street is set to none

heading_tolerance.description: When a heading is supplied, this is the tolerance around that heading with which we determine whether an edges heading is similar enough to match the supplied heading

mvt_min_zoom_road_class.description: Minimum zoom level for each road class (8 values: Motorway, Trunk, Primary, Secondary, Tertiary, Unclassified, Residential, Service/Other). Roads will only be rendered at or above their minimum zoom level.

mvt_cache_dir.description: The cache directory for MVT tiles. If empty/omitted, we disable MVT caching

mvt_cache_min_zoom.description: The minimum zoom level which will be cached, the maximum will be determined by mvt_min_zoom_road_class

mvt_max_age.description: The value used for 'max-age' in the Cache-Control response header for the MVT end point

proxy.description: IPC linux domain socket file location

source_to_target_algorithm.description: Which matrix algorithm should be used, one of "timedistancematrix" or "costmatrix". If blank, the optimal will be selected.

proxy.description: IPC linux domain socket file location

max_reserved_labels_count_astar.description: Maximum capacity allowed to keep reserved for unidirectional A*.

max_reserved_labels_count_bidir_astar.description: Maximum capacity allowed to keep reserved for bidirectional A*.

max_reserved_labels_count_dijkstras.description: Maximum capacity allowed to keep reserved for unidirectional Dijkstras.

max_reserved_labels_count_bidir_dijkstra.description: Maximum capacity allowed to keep reserved for bidirectional Dijkstras.

clear_reserved_memory.description: If True clean reserved memory in path algorithms

extended_search.description: If True and 1 side of the bidirectional search is exhausted, causes the other side to continue if the starting location of that side began on a not_thru or closed edge

check_reverse_connection.description: Whether to check for expansion connections on the reverse tree, which has an adverse effect on performance

allow_second_pass.description: Whether to allow a second pass for unfound CostMatrix connections, where we turn off destination-only, relax hierarchies and expand into "semi-islands"

max_reserved_locations.description: Maximum amount of locations allowed to to keep reserved between requests for CostMatrix

max_iterations.description: Upper bound on the number of iterations per expansion once a path has been found. Must be a positive integer

min_iterations.description: Lower bound on the number of iterations per expansion once a path has been found. Must be a positive integer

dijkstra_distance.description: Distance in meters from a source/target within which its tree expands with a zero heuristic, i.e. like Dijkstra. Makes the found connections independent of where the other locations lie, at the cost of expanding more edges. 0 disables it. Default 0.

1.description: The default maximum up transitions for level 1 in CostMatrix

2.description: The default maximum up transitions for level 2 in CostMatrix

0.description: The default distance within which expansion is allowed from the origin/destination on level 0 in costmatrix

1.description: The default distance within which expansion is allowed from the origin/destination on level 1 in costmatrix

2.description: The default distance within which expansion is allowed from the origin/destination on level 2 in costmatrix

threshold_delta.description: Time (seconds) to extend search once the first connection has been found

alternative_cost_extend.description: Relative cost extension to find alternative routes

alternative_iterations_delta.description: Number of extra iterations to allow when searching for alternative paths. Higher values will find more alternatives but will be slower

2.description: The default maximum up transitions for level 2 in CostMatrix

markup_enabled.description: Boolean flag to use markup formatting

phoneme_format.description: The phoneme format string that will be used by street names and signs

customizable.description: Specify which parameters are allowed to be customized by URL query parameters

sigma_z.description: A non-negative value to specify the GPS accuracy (the variance of the normal distribution) of an incoming GPS sequence. It is also used to weight emission costs of measurements

beta.description: A non-negative emprical value to weight the transition cost of two successive candidates

max_route_distance_factor.description: A non-negative value used to limit the routing search range which is the distance to next measurement multiplied by this factor

max_route_time_factor.description: A non-negative value used to limit the routing search range which is the time to the next measurement multiplied by this factor

max_search_radius.description: A non-negative value specifying the maximum radius in meters about a given point to search for candidate edges for routing

breakage_distance.description: A non-negative value. If two successive measurements are far than this distance, then connectivity in between will not be considered

interpolation_distance.description: If two successive measurements are closer than this distance, then the later one will be interpolated into the matched route

search_radius.description: A non-negative value to specify the search radius (in meters) within which to search road candidates for each measurement

turn_penalty_factor.description: A non-negative value to penalize turns from one road segment to next
